0022600161.text: The Knicks (2-4) host the Nets (1-5) in their seventh game of the season, with New York 11th in the East and fourth in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, while Brooklyn is 15th in the East and fifth in the Atlantic, 4.5 games back, though the Nets come in on a one-game winning streak and the Knicks on a one-game losing streak. Brooklyn will be without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won all four meetings in 2025-26, and their most recent game was a 93-92 win in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026.
